what: Checkpoints behind the published Table 2 / Figure 1 cells. Inventory only: no checkpoint is committed to this repository.
path_note: checkpoint_relpath and config_relpath are relative to the run tree root on the cluster the runs were produced on; they are not paths inside this repository. run_dir names are legacy and are not run_ids: map at read time.
method_spelling_note: this manifest spells the method 'mrfp+'; the paper and the rest of the code use 'mrfp_plus' in code and run_ids and 'MRFP+' in prose.
not_included: SIB, CrossEarth, BSM and SAR checkpoints are not in this manifest; it covers the seven published LOCO baselines plus the within-city upper bounds.
